subject: ACME — pricing & context-length profiling follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: ACME — pricing & context-length profiling follow-up

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + next steps so we have alignment before we scope a profiling run and pilot:

Call recap (high-level)
- Primary use cases: document summarization (internal knowledge base), customer response generation (short replies), and long-form report generation for a subset of workflows.
- Key constraints: latency for customer-facing replies (~500ms target p95 for short flows), retention/security for documents, and predictable unit cost.

Context-length + output profiling asks (what we need from you)
- Avg prompt tokens (examples): please provide 10-20 representative prompts or averages across use cases.
- Avg completion tokens: typical lengths and tail: e.g., 200-1,000 tokens for replies vs 3k-20k for reports.
- % of requests by output size bucket: short (<512 tokens), medium (512-4k), long (4k-32k), archive/very long (>32k).
- Which flows will require 8k vs 32k vs 128k context windows?

Initial questions for pricing qualification
- Estimated monthly token volumes (prompt tokens + completion tokens).
- Budget range for the pilot / production (monthly).
- Target unit economics: any target $/1M tokens you’re aiming for (this helps us propose a pricing structure and commit level).

Attachments: I attached a short CSV you can fill out with example prompt/completion averages and distribution (context_length_survey.csv). If you prefer, you can drop a sample export (acme_sample_outputs.zip) or a Slack snippet.

Proposed next steps
1) You fill the survey and send any sample files (if available).
2) We run a 1-2 week profiling run to measure token distribution, latency, and cost across 8k/32k configs.
3) We review results and propose a pilot pricing MAP (3 months) with suggested $/1M token targets.

Would you be able to share the avg token numbers and an estimated monthly volume by end of week? I can schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk through the profiling plan.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

[Attachment: context_length_survey.csv (text/csv)]

From: Alex Green <alex.green@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME — pricing & context-length profiling follow-up

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few numbers to start with (high level, subject to confirmation):

- Estimated monthly volumes (current prod + expected growth):
  • Prompt tokens: ~2.1M / month
  • Completion tokens: ~7.9M / month
  • Total tokens: ~10M / month

- Output size distribution (approx):
  • Short (<512): 65% (customer replies, quick summaries)
  • Medium (512-4k): 25% (detailed summaries, multi-paragraph replies)
  • Long (4k-32k): 9% (quarterly reports, long document syntheses)
  • Very long (>32k): <1% (rarities)

- Context window needs:
  • Customer replies and most summaries: 8k is sufficient
  • Document syntheses and a few report workflows: 32k desired
  • 128k: not required in current roadmap but could be needed for large-archive builds in 12-18 months

- Budget range: right now leadership is targeting $4k–$8k / month for model inference (pilot), with potential to expand if the unit economics work out in production.

Attached is a small export of sample outputs (sanitized) that shows token counts for a week (acme_sample_outputs.zip).

Let me know if you need anything else. We can do the profiling run and then reconvene — happy to block 30 mins next Wed.

Best,
Alex
Senior Product Manager | ACME Corp
alex.green@acme.com
[Attachment: acme_sample_outputs.zip (application/zip)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME — pricing & context-length profiling follow-up

Alex — really helpful, thanks for the data. Based on the numbers you provided I sketched a target unit-economics approach so we can be explicit in the MAP:

Quick unit-economics sketch (back-of-envelope)
- Expected baseline tokens: ~10M/month total
- If we target $/1M tokens = $75, monthly cost = (10 * $75) = $750/month
  (this is just the variable inference cost baseline — infra/support/SLAs bump the effective contract cost).
- For pilot pricing, given your $4k–$8k pilot budget, we can propose a 3-month pilot at $3k/month with profiling reports + 30k calls free for benchmarking.

Notes & asks
- We’ll prioritize profiling for 8k and 32k since that covers 94% of your traffic today. 128k is optional later.
- For accurate proposal I still need the filled survey (avg prompt & completion tokens per flow) and the sample outputs you attached (we have them).
- Can you confirm whether the $4k–$8k budget is for inference-only or includes SRE/support/observability? That affects how we structure discounts/commit.

Next steps (proposed)
1) Redwood runs a 2-week profiling job across 8k and 32k configs using your sample data.
2) We deliver a profiling report with expected unit costs and latency SLO projections.
3) Agree MAP for a 3-month pilot: flat fee + token allowance + overage $/1M token rate.

I’ll attach a draft MAP (ACME_MAP_v1.pdf) and my proposed pricing structure in the doc. Can we meet Wed 16 Jun at 10:30 AM PT to review?

Thanks — I’ll set the invite and include Rishi to help with commitment-level approvals.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: ACME_MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal — ACME pricing notes / ask for approval

Rishi — quick internal note summarizing the thread and ask for pricing approval before I send the MAP:

Summary:
- ACME expects ~10M tokens/month; mix weighted to short/medium; 32k needed for ~9% of traffic.
- Leadership pilot budget: $4k–$8k/month. They’re not asking for 128k now.

Recommendation (what I want to offer in the MAP):
- 3-month pilot at $3k/month (fixed), includes profiling + 10M token allowance/month.
- Overage pricing at $75 / 1M tokens (post-allowance).
- 15% enterprise discount on list for first year if they commit to 12 months after pilot.

Ask: can we approve the pilot structure (3mo $3k + 10M tokens, overage $75/1M) and the 15% follow-on discount? If we need to tweak the $/1M to $85 to keep margins, say so and I’ll adjust wording.

Also flag: need SIG/Security checklist for the profiling job — we should run in a customer-isolated environment for their internal docs.

Thanks — I’ll wait for your thumbs-up before sending the MAP to ACME.

Marissa
